author: prabhatsolanki
body: New package `DataFormats/VertexGNNReco`, introduced in cms-sw/cmssw#51862 (vertex-slot GNN primary-vertex reconstruction for Phase-2). It holds the Alpaka portable SoA collections of the track features and of the GNN output, so it is added to the `reconstruction` and `heterogeneous` categories, next to `DataFormats/VertexReco` and `DataFormats/VertexSoA`.
title: Add VertexGNNReco to categories map
